'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Ken Cross DS isb operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ken Cross]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ken Cross]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Tatooine Cross DS ISB.txt |Download]]
